description: The chart displays the distribution of categories for four different models, namely GPT4-o, Gemini1.5, Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, and Llama3.1-405B-Instruct. Each model is represented by a pie chart, with the number of slices varying across models. The GPT4-o chart has 2 slices, labeled "Lack of Knowledge" (red, approximately 83.3%) and "Safety" (orange, approximately 16.7%). The Gemini1.5 chart has 5 slices, labeled "Misinformation" (orange, approximately 38.4%), "Lack of Knowledge" (blue, approximately 22.1%), "Ethical Advice" (light blue, approximately 16.3%), "Clarification" (yellow, approximately 14.0%), and "Safety" (red, approximately 9.3%). The Llama3.1-70B-Instruct chart has 2 slices, labeled "Lack of Knowledge" (light orange, approximately 75.0%) and "Clarification" (dark red, approximately 25.0%). The Llama3.1-405B-Instruct chart also has 2 slices, labeled "Lack of Knowledge" (light orange, approximately 50.0%) and "Misinformation" (red, approximately 50.0%). All charts display percentage labels inside the slices, and the slices are distinguishable by color. The charts do not include a legend, and no slices are visually emphasized. The slices in each chart are not ordered in a particular way.
